description: Curated BBB-relevant gene families. Categorized as 'help' (drug delivery routes / nutrient transport in) or 'hindrance' (efflux / barrier function).

categories.name: Tight Junctions
categories.description: Paracellular barrier — seals the BBB against passive diffusion of polar molecules. Loss of tight junction integrity is a hallmark of BBB disruption (stroke, MS, Alzheimer's).
categories.subtitle: Sealing the paracellular space

genes.name: Claudin-5
genes.note: Dominant tight-junction protein in brain endothelium. Knockout causes size-selective barrier loss.

genes.name: Claudin-3
genes.note: Co-expressed with CLDN5 in brain endothelium.

genes.name: Claudin-12
genes.note: Reported at BBB; functional role debated.

genes.name: Occludin
genes.note: TJ regulatory protein; phosphorylation modulates barrier.

categories.name: Adherens Junctions
categories.description: Calcium-dependent endothelial cell-cell adhesion. Provides mechanical integrity beneath tight junctions.
categories.subtitle: Mechanical scaffold of EC contacts

genes.name: VE-cadherin
genes.note: Master regulator of endothelial cell-cell adhesion.

categories.name: ABC Efflux Transporters
categories.description: ATP-driven efflux pumps that expel drugs from BBB endothelium back to blood. Major obstacle for CNS drug delivery — most small-molecule CNS drugs in clinical use are NOT P-gp/BCRP substrates by design.
categories.subtitle: Drug efflux at the luminal membrane

genes.name: MDR1 / P-gp
genes.note: The most studied efflux pump; substrate spectrum spans most cationic and amphipathic drugs.

genes.name: BCRP
genes.note: Half-transporter dimer; restricts entry of TKIs, statins, antivirals.

genes.name: ABCA1
genes.note: Cholesterol efflux; affects BBB lipid homeostasis.

categories.name: Receptor-Mediated Transcytosis
categories.description: Receptors on the luminal endothelial surface that bind ligands and shuttle them across the BBB. The leading strategy for biologic drug delivery (antibodies, fusion proteins) into the CNS.
categories.subtitle: Drug delivery vehicles

genes.name: Transferrin Receptor (CD71)
genes.note: Most validated BBB shuttle target; multiple bispecific antibody platforms (Denali, Roche, Genentech).

genes.name: IGF-1 Receptor
genes.note: Cross-reactive with INSR; alternative shuttle target.

categories.name: Transcytosis Regulators
categories.description: Suppressors of vesicular trafficking. Brain capillary endothelium has uniquely low transcytosis — MFSD2A is the master switch (Andreone et al. 2017).
categories.subtitle: Why brain ECs have low pinocytosis

genes.name: MFSD2A / Mfsd2a
genes.note: DHA-LPC importer; suppresses caveolae-mediated transcytosis. Specific to BBB capillary ECs.

genes.name: Caveolin-1
genes.note: Caveolae structural protein; low in BBB ECs vs peripheral.

genes.name: PLVAP / PV-1
genes.note: Fenestrae diaphragm protein. Absent from continuous BBB; present in fenestrated CNS endothelium (CVOs, choroid plexus).

categories.name: Glucose & Hexose Transporters
categories.description: Carrier-mediated transport of glucose and other hexoses across the BBB.
categories.subtitle: Brain energy supply

genes.name: GLUT1
genes.note: Dominant brain endothelial glucose transporter. SLC2A1 deficiency = De Vivo disease.

categories.name: Amino Acid Transporters
categories.description: Move large neutral, cationic, anionic, and small AAs across BBB. LAT1 is also exploited as a drug-delivery vehicle (gabapentin, L-DOPA).
categories.subtitle: Amino acid supply & drug delivery

genes.name: LAT1
genes.note: Large neutral AA transporter; transports L-DOPA, gabapentin, melphalan.

categories.name: Monocarboxylate Transporters
categories.description: Lactate, pyruvate, ketone bodies. Brain energy delivery especially during ketosis. Drug substrates include some statins.
categories.subtitle: Lactate & ketone transport

categories.name: Organic Anion / Cation Transporters
categories.description: OATs/OCTs/OATPs handle endogenous metabolites and many drugs. Direction (uptake vs efflux) depends on substrate and membrane localization.
categories.subtitle: Drug & metabolite handling

genes.name: OAT3
genes.note: Penicillin and methotrexate efflux at BBB.

categories.name: Nucleoside / Vitamin / Ion Transporters
categories.description: Carry nucleosides, vitamins, ions across the BBB.
categories.subtitle: Micronutrient delivery

categories.name: Metabolic Barrier Enzymes
categories.description: Cytochrome P450s and conjugation enzymes degrade xenobiotics within BBB endothelium — the 'metabolic barrier' alongside the physical TJ barrier.
categories.subtitle: Enzymatic detoxification at BBB

categories.name: Endothelial Identity Markers
categories.description: Pan-endothelial markers used to identify ECs in single-cell datasets.
categories.subtitle: EC identity

categories.name: EC Zonation Markers (Art / Cap / Ven)
categories.description: Genes whose expression is enriched in arterial, capillary, or venous endothelial cells. Useful for classifying EC subtypes.
categories.subtitle: Arteriovenous specification

categories.name: Pericyte Markers
categories.description: Mural cells embedded in the basement membrane of capillaries. Critical for BBB induction and maintenance (Armulik 2010, Daneman 2010).
categories.subtitle: BBB-inducing mural cells

categories.name: Smooth Muscle Cell Markers
categories.description: Vascular SMCs surround arterioles; contractile, regulate cerebral blood flow.
categories.subtitle: Arteriole contractility

categories.name: Fibroblast Markers
categories.description: Perivascular fibroblasts produce ECM around large vessels; distinct from pericytes.
categories.subtitle: Perivascular ECM production

categories.name: ECM / Basement Membrane
categories.description: Specialized basement membrane between endothelium and astrocyte endfeet.
categories.subtitle: BBB scaffold

categories.name: Integrins & Adhesion
categories.description: Mediate EC adhesion to BM and leukocyte transmigration.
categories.subtitle: Cell-matrix and leukocyte adhesion

categories.name: GPCRs at the BBB
categories.description: Major druggable receptor class; modulators of cerebral blood flow, permeability, and tone.
categories.subtitle: Druggable signaling

categories.name: Wnt / β-Catenin Signaling
categories.description: Wnt7a/Wnt7b signaling from neural progenitors via FZD/LRP/GPR124/RECK induces and maintains the BBB. Essential for barrier specification.
categories.subtitle: BBB induction & maintenance

categories.name: Neurodegeneration / GWAS
categories.description: Genes implicated in BBB dysfunction in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS, and small-vessel disease.
categories.subtitle: BBB in disease

categories.name: Astrocyte Markers (NOT in atlas)
categories.description: Astrocyte endfeet contact ECs and induce barrier properties. Astrocytes are NOT included in this atlas (vascular-only) but key markers are listed for cross-reference.
categories.subtitle: BBB-supporting glia (not profiled here)
